title: 'BTS ARMY: Forever We Are Young' Documentary Opens in Theaters Worldwide
detail: July 30, 2026 — The fan documentary 'BTS ARMY: Forever We Are Young,' directed by Grace Lee and Patty Anh, opens in theaters worldwide via Trafalgar Releasing. The film follows ARMY members across continents, blending personal stories with the fandom's global milestones to explore the passion, creativity, and activism that built BTS into a global phenomenon rather than focusing on the group itself. Tickets went on sale July 2 through the film's official site, with select cinemas offering branded concessions and exclusive posters.

media.caption: 'BTS ARMY: Forever We Are Young' opens in theaters worldwide, spotlighting the fandom's global impact.

title: Toronto City Council Approves Temporary 'BTS Boulevard' Street Renaming
detail: July 29-30, 2026 — Toronto City Council adopts a motion, introduced by Councillor Lily Cheng, to temporarily co-name the stretch of Yonge Street between North York Boulevard and Finch Avenue as 'BTS Boulevard' from on or about August 21 through September 23, welcoming ARMY ahead of BTS's ARIRANG World Tour concerts at Rogers Stadium on August 22-23. The council also requests Mayor Olivia Chow proclaim August 22-23 'BTS Weekend' and asks that Toronto's City Hall sign be illuminated in purple for the concert dates; the commemorative street signs will later be auctioned for local charities. Installation of the temporary signage remains contingent on the city securing intellectual-property permission from Big Hit Music.

media.caption: Toronto City Council approves temporarily renaming part of Yonge Street 'BTS Boulevard' ahead of the group's Rogers Stadium shows.
